goal: Deploy bounded, modular recovery: isolate typed remote client failures for every queued origin, remove provider-ceiling lifecycle deadlock safely, fix provisioning retry ambiguity, and give independent lifecycle account lanes and measured module progress without weakening durable mutation safety.
context: Continue canonical a6b1826 and docs/ISOLATION_RISK_FORECAST_20261007.json. Main implementer handles code; use OpenAI adapter only for plan/review (no delegated agents). Existing driver/plugin interfaces remain authority. Extend RunOne typed panel COOLDOWN/QUARANTINED handling to manual/bulk queued jobs; no nil/malformed inventory proves absence. Keep direct guarded-canary behavior and journal outcome observable. Preserve global client concurrency1/executor lock, finite budgets, policy/auth, ownership, no blind ambiguous POST, quarantine never auto-cleared. Fix psa.next_retry_at qualification and propagate SQL errors except true absent row. Capacity: below Desired but full fresh provider capacity may atomically retire exactly one oldest expired managed server under account lock, with no active retirement/pending create/backfill; stale/unknown/zero/error/disabled capacity cannot authorize delete. Keep Desired and scheduler ownership. Lifecycle use existing bounded dispatcher per-account1, configurable cooperative deadline, no overlapping same key, cancellation then join, failure ledger safe read/write and retry. Add reusable module progress snapshots to production heartbeat and readiness for client mutation loop: report scan/completion separately, gated/idle isn't work success, failed DB/gate isn't healthy mutation. Never promise complete isolation or indefinite uptime; remaining shared process/lock risks recorded. Fault/race/Postgres tests, full Go, source review, clean checkpoint, staged deployment/config preservation/readback. Live no test cloud fixtures or destructive fault injection.
